thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate detected for /v1/generate across gateway-prod - 5xx spike + timeouts. Severity: P2. Assigned to oncall: tilly. Links: https://dash.re/redwood/incidents/1775309123, runbook: https://go/re/runbooks/gateway-5xx

tilly: on it. seeing ~18% 5xx for last 3m, latency tail increased. checking dashboards now.

meera: I can see a correlated uptick in 429s at the quota layer around the same time window. Looks like token-bucket drops spiking for region-us-west.

antoine: 429 -> retry storms often push downstream services to 5xx, yep. Any recent config changes?

meera: There was a quota policy rollout from this morning that tightened per-tenant burst allowances. I’m pulling the diff.

meera: diff snippet:
```
-  burst_window_seconds: 60
-  max_burst_tokens: 500
+  burst_window_seconds: 30
+  max_burst_tokens: 200
```

tilly: that'd explain it. customers retry quickly, gateway + runtime overloaded -> 5xx timeouts.

antoine: can we confirm affected surface? which tenants and which endpoints?

meera: initial scope: high-traffic tenants A123, B987, C321. Endpoints: /v1/generate (chat + streaming), /v1/embed (sporadic). Rate of 429s peaked 17:04 UTC.

tilly: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily relax quota policy to previous values 2) enable gateway-level short-circuit fallback to read-only cached model for heavy tenants 3) add 1 extra gateway instance in us-west. Who can execute 1 & 2?

antoine: I can roll back the quota change. Need quick patch to quota-service. Rolling patch via k8s. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra set image deployment/quota-service quota-service=quotalatest:2026.03.10
kubectl -n infra apply -f /configs/quota-rollbacks/previous-burst.yaml
```

meera: I'm on quota-service. I'll patch and watch. Starting now.

sre-bot: Action logged: meera triggered rollout of /configs/quota-rollbacks/previous-burst.yaml at 2026-03-15T17:06:35Z.

meera: patch applied. watching observability.

tilly: I’ll trigger extra gateway instance and route a small percentage of traffic to fallback model variant.

tilly: command to scale gateway: `k scale deployment gateway-prod --replicas=6 -n prod`

antoine: scaling kicked off.

tilly: changing routing for heavy tenants to fallback (10%):
```
PATCH /api/v1/routing
{
  "tenant_ids": ["A123","B987","C321"],
  "route_overrides": {"/v1/generate": {"fallback_variant": "small-cache","percent": 10}}
}
```

olivia: heads-up: product wants a short customer note if we expect visible degraded throughput. jake, can you prep an outbound?

jake: I’ll draft a brief status line: "We’re seeing elevated errors due to quota enforcement changes earlier today; we’ve rolled back the config and are applying mitigations. Some requests may see slower responses or cached fallbacks for a short period." Will post to affected customers once we confirm trend improving.

meera: metrics update: 5xx dropping from 18% -> 6% in last 5m, 429s down 70%.

tilly: nice. keep an eye on downstream runtimes for KV cache pressure.

antoine: One odd thing: logs show gateways returning 502s with payload "upstream: connection reset by peer" — likely overloaded runtime worker pool. Scaling should help.

meera: increasing runtime worker pool as precaution on the heavy hosts: `./infractl runtime scale --hosts hostset-heavy --workers +20`

sre-bot: Action logged: runtime scaling initiated by meera at 2026-03-15T17:12:40Z.

tilly: OK. monitoring SLOs. Can we keep fallback for 30m then re-evaluate?

antoine: fine. I'll also put a temporary longer retry-backoff in gateway for 429s to avoid retry storms: set client retry jitter 200-800ms -> 500-2500ms.

meera: confirmed runtime worker increase applied. CPU spiking but stable; error budget burn trending down.

tilly: any residual customer impact? jake?

jake: picked top 3 affected customers and DMing them now with the draft. No major escalations yet.

olivia: product ok with the approach. Please call if we need to move to incident call.

tilly: post-mortem action items so far: 1) revert rollout gating so quota policy rollouts require smoke testing against high-load tenants 2) add breakpoint in deployment pipeline to alert SRE if 429s flip >5% within 10m 3) add automated fallback route for quota-induced surge.

antoine: adding runbook note: if quota rollback is required, prefer config patch w/ gradual canary rather than full tighten.

meera: logs show rollback completed cleanly at 17:09:12Z.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (quota rollback + gateway scaling + fallback routes). Error rates decreased. Status: degrading -> stabilizing. Next: oncall to file incident report and runbook updates.

tilly: thanks all. I'll open the incident postmortem and tag action owners. Leaving channel in 15m unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

jake: will follow up with customers if we see any late errors.

olivia: mark me on postmortem for product impact notes.

meera: leaving a note in the runbook about the exact quota diff and the rollback steps.

tilly: closing the pager; move to monitoring.

sre-bot: Pager closed by tilly at 2026-03-15T17:33:20Z.

tilly: Final status: incident contained, root cause = aggressive quota rollout that reduced burst tokens causing retry storms and downstream overload. Actions assigned in postmortem.

antoine: +1 good triage.

jake: sending customer notes now.

tilly: thread will be referenced in postmortem: incident-1775309123.
